from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_revision_prior_policy_clock_v1'
parent=root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1'
result=json.loads((parent/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert result['full_account_admission_passed'] is False
assert not out.exists();out.mkdir();(out/'sources').mkdir()
stamp=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
proposal={'proposal_id':'E13_SOMA_REVISION_PRIOR_POLICY_CLOCK','status':'REGISTERED_SOURCE_ONLY_NOT_RUN',
    'question':'2024Q3借款下修中SOMA预估调整的上游政策安排，在2024-07-29借款公告前是否已经公开？',
    'reason':'E12季度两原因没有增量；源构成显示2024Q3其他融资改善94、SOMA memo变化86，需核政策首次公开与后续计划更新时点，不能自动称新预期差。',
    'quarter_selected_from_source_causes_not_equity_returns':True,'new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,
    'original_E12_rejection_preserved':True,'orders_authorized':False}
(parent/'next_experiment.json').write_text(json.dumps(proposal,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
protocol={'study_id':'510300_TREASURY_SOMA_REVISION_PRIOR_POLICY_CLOCK_V1','experiment_id':'E13','registered_at':stamp,
    'phase':'SOURCE_ONLY_PRIOR_POLICY_PUBLICATION_CLOCK',
    'question':proposal['question'],'fixed_quarter':'2024Q3','prior_treasury_date':'2024-04-29','current_treasury_date':'2024-07-29',
    'source_scope':{'new_official_statement_url':'https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20240501a.htm',
        'max_new_pages':1,'max_concurrency':1,'attempts':2,'do_not_retry_403_429':True,
        'reuse_treasury_originals':['reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/sources/2024Q2_借款预估原公布.html',
            'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/sources/2024Q3_借款预估原公布.html',
            'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/sources/2024Q2_资金来源与用途原表.pdf',
            'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/sources/2024Q3_资金来源与用途原表.pdf']},
    'fields':'FOMC正文实际日/正式发布时间/减持上限原新值/生效月份/是否同步降政策利率；Treasury同Q3两SOMA预估/其他融资修订/当前正文解释。',
    'decision_question':'上游政策公开是否早于当前借款修订；是否晚于原4月预测。只认证先后，不认证市场预期或价格已完全吸收。',
    'no_amount_overclaim':'月度上限变化不直接乘3强制解释全部SOMA86；实际到期分布、票据兜底、跨季现金结算、实际持券仍影响金额。SOMA memo不重复计入其他融资。',
    'known_selection':'已看E11全季度/E12失败/旧32次FOMC窗口；5月1日已存在原32窗口，但未将其QT原文与两借款计划连线，不是未见金融样本。选择依据来源构成，不依据A股收益。',
    'old_financial_research_boundary':'不重跑原32次FOMC5/20日收益、E6/E9/E12评分或账户。没有新A股标签、拟合/账户、分组方向或前瞻。',
    'source_first_vintage_and_market_consensus_certified':False,'parameter_searches':0,'new_repository_source_edits':0,
    'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
p=out/'protocol.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
inputs=['reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1/result.json',
    'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1/next_experiment.json',
    'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/原公告字段及原因记录.json',
    'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/所有原PDF页面文字.json',
    'reports/research/510300_historical_fomc_transmission_v1/protocol.json',
    'reports/research/510300_historical_fomc_transmission_v1/result.json']
inputs+=protocol['source_scope']['reuse_treasury_originals']
freeze={'registered_at':stamp,'before_new_Fed_statement_or_new_equity_labels':True,'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'input_hashes':{rel:hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in inputs}}
(out/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('E13来源先后问题已登记：固定2024Q3，最多1新Fed原页，复用4Treasury原件；原32次金融窗口和E12拒绝不重跑。')
